principle.name: THE ELBOW STOPS BEFORE THE BODY DOES
principle.pocket_rule: EARN A COMPACT STRIKE WITH ROOT TRAVEL, PIN THE CONTACT JOINT BRIEFLY WHILE THE TORSO SPENDS FORCE THROUGH IT, THEN PEEL THE LIMB BEFORE THE BODY FINISHES OVERRUNNING.
principle.fresh_interpretation: A barehand lateral strike uses a crossed-foot load and deep shoulder coil, then an authored pelvis-first bridge. The elbow is withheld until the root owns the lane, enters on a curved path, establishes explicit precontact/contact, remains fixed while the pelvis compresses forward/down, disengages before recoil, and recovers on a delayed arm clock after the support catch.

keys.name: OFFSET_READY
keys.causal_role: unequal ready establishes a rear-loaded striking shoulder and open front-side guard
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis sits behind front foot; striking elbow is folded close and rear of chest

keys.name: REAR_SINK
keys.causal_role: rear support sink buys rotational room before any attack limb travels toward target
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis drops back-left; chest follows less, increasing torso/pelvis torsion

keys.name: CROSSSTEP_TRANSIT
keys.causal_role: rear foot travels under the root to create a narrow unstable transit rather than a planted mannequin pose
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis advances while rear foot crosses behind the lead; shoulders deliberately remain turned away

keys.name: DEEP_SHOULDER_COIL
keys.causal_role: crossed support locks in a deep asymmetric shoulder coil with the striking elbow hidden rearward
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root stays low and slightly right while chest counter-rotates left; striking elbow climbs behind rib line

keys.name: PELVIS_FIRE_BRIDGE
keys.causal_role: authored body-first bridge: pelvis fires down-forward while striking elbow is still withheld
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis advances six cells before elbow meaningfully approaches target; chest remains partially wound

keys.name: ELBOW_ENTRY
keys.causal_role: strike elbow escapes on a curved cross-body line only after pelvis and chest have earned the lane
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root surges right; shoulder overtakes pelvis late; hand stays folded so elbow clearly owns the strike

keys.name: PRECONTACT
keys.causal_role: distinct one-beat precontact establishes a visible gap and prevents contact from merely being farthest reach
keys.motion_arc_root_note: elbow approaches within two cells of target while pelvis remains behind the shoulder

keys.name: CONTACT_INSTANT
keys.causal_role: explicit authored elbow contact instant with hit-stop implication but no invented source duration
keys.motion_arc_root_note: elbow reaches the target while root changes only slightly from precontact

keys.name: PINNED_CRUSH
keys.causal_role: fixed contact becomes a temporary joint while the body folds diagonally through it; root drops before later overrun
keys.motion_arc_root_note: elbow remains fixed; pelvis advances only one cell but drops three while chest moves farther forward, creating a diagonal crush line; rear support stretches back and peels

keys.name: AUTHORED_PEEL
keys.causal_role: elbow breaks contact before any recoil, making disengage a real authored event rather than reverse interpolation
keys.motion_arc_root_note: after the diagonal crush, elbow peels down-left while pelvis continues three cells forward and rear foot stays light behind

keys.name: BODY_OVERRUN
keys.causal_role: body continues through the line after the striking limb has folded, preserving momentum debt
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis nearly reaches target line; chest passes former shoulder line while rear leg trails airborne

keys.name: COUNTER_RECOIL_CATCH
keys.causal_role: support catches the overrunning body while shoulder rebounds opposite the still-lagging strike arm
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis snaps left/up modestly; rear foot replants wide; elbow trails farther left than shoulder

keys.name: ARM_SECONDARY_LAG
keys.causal_role: striking elbow and hand overshoot behind the recovering root on a delayed secondary clock
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis settles left/down while strike arm continues left/back, opening a large right-side negative space

keys.name: CROOKED_SETTLE_DEBT
keys.causal_role: recovery ends displaced, wide, and still rotated rather than returning to the opening ready pose
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root remains twenty cells forward of original rear sink; torso is canted and strike arm hangs low-rear

tango_rounds.highest_value_visible_defect: The four-frame pinned crush stacked pelvis/chest too vertically against the impact post, briefly reading like a mannequin pressed to a wall instead of force passing diagonally through a constrained elbow.
tango_rounds.concrete_correction: Re-author K8 with a lower/back pelvis, forward chest, long rear-support stretch and fixed contact elbow; re-author K9 so contact peels before the root finishes overrunning.

tango_rounds.why: Revised pin phase retains the fixed elbow but folds the body diagonally through it; cross-step coil, pelvis-first release, precontact/contact, pinned crush, authored peel, body overrun, counter-recoil, arm lag and displaced settle remain visually distinct.

noodle_queen.taste: Crossed-foot coil, compact elbow ownership and diagonal pinned crush create a recognizable silhouette sequence rather than weapon-reskin vocabulary.
noodle_queen.function: load -> crossstep -> coil -> pelvis-fire -> entry -> precontact -> contact -> pinned crush -> peel -> overrun -> support catch -> secondary lag -> displaced settle is causally legible.
noodle_queen.contempt: The body keeps paying forward/rotational debt after the elbow leaves contact; recovery stays wide and crooked instead of politely returning to ready.
